name: deepseek-harness
display_name: DeepSeek Harness / dsh (Windows, non-A2A control group)
description: DeepSeek AI's open-source agent harness (dsh). On Windows use the npm package from PowerShell; the commands match the Ubuntu variant, only the Node.js installation method and paths differ. The Web UI defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3080. It does not implement A2A or publish an Agent Card. This entry is kept as a control group showing how a non-A2A asset is registered.

metadata.install: winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS  # or nvm-windows; requires Node.js 22.19+
metadata.a2a: unsupported — the Web UI on :3080 is not an A2A server; see example/README_cn.md for how the control group is marked
